WITH HighSchools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSoffered, GSserved
  FROM schools
  WHERE NCESDist = '0613360'
    AND StatusType = 'Operating'
    AND GSoffered LIKE '%12%'  -- Schools that offer grade 12
),
ServingGrade12 AS (
  -- Filter high schools that actually serve grade 12 (means GSserved includes 12)
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSserved
  FROM HighSchools
  WHERE GSserved LIKE '%12%'
),
SATCounts AS (
  -- Sum SAT test takers by school
  SELECT cds, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS total_takers
  FROM satscores
  GROUP BY cds
),
NoSATTakers AS (
  -- Join schools with SAT counts, treat no SAT records as zero takers
  SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.GSserved, IFNULL(sc.total_takers, 0) AS total_takers
  FROM ServingGrade12 s
  LEFT JOIN SATCounts sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
  WHERE IFNULL(sc.total_takers, 0) = 0
),
GradeRank AS (
  -- Assign rank based on earliest grade served considering PK < K < 1 < 2 < ...
  SELECT CDSCode, School, GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%PK%' THEN 0
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%K%' THEN 1
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%1%' THEN 2
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%2%' THEN 3
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%3%' THEN 4
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%4%' THEN 5
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%5%' THEN 6
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%6%' THEN 7
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%7%' THEN 8
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%8%' THEN 9
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%9%' THEN 10
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%10%' THEN 11
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%11%' THEN 12
      WHEN GSserved LIKE '%12%' THEN 13
      ELSE 100 -- Unknown or no grades found
    END AS LowestGradeRank
  FROM NoSATTakers
),
MinGradeRank AS (
  SELECT MIN(LowestGradeRank) AS MinRank
  FROM GradeRank
)
SELECT School, GSserved
FROM GradeRank, MinGradeRank
WHERE LowestGradeRank = MinRank
ORDER BY School ASC
;

WITH distinct_grades AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT GSoffered AS grades FROM schools WHERE NCESDist = '0632640' AND GSoffered IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT GSserved AS grades FROM schools WHERE NCESDist = '0632640' AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
),
parsed_grades AS (
  SELECT grades,
  CASE
    WHEN substr(grades, 1, 1) = 'P' THEN 0
    WHEN substr(grades, 1, 1) = 'K' THEN 1
    ELSE CAST(substr(grades, 1, instr(grades, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER)
  END AS start_grade_value
  FROM distinct_grades
)
SELECT
CASE MIN(start_grade_value)
  WHEN 0 THEN 'P'
  WHEN 1 THEN 'K'
  ELSE CAST(MIN(start_grade_value) AS TEXT)
END AS lowest_begin_grade
FROM parsed_grades;

  FROM GradeLevels

),
FilteredSchools AS (
  SELECT f.[CDSCode] AS cds_code, f.[County Name] AS county_name, f.[Charter School (Y/N)] AS charter_indicator, f.[Enrollment (K-12)] AS enrollment_k12,
         f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] AS free_meal_count_k12, f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS frpm_count_k12, f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)] AS free_meal_percent_k12,

  FROM frpm f

SchoolSAT AS (

Aggregated AS (

    SELECT p.account_id, p.opening_date

),

    SELECT l.account_id, SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM loan l
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
Counterparties AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS outside_counterparties
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account ac ON t.account_id = ac.account_id
    WHERE (t.type = 'T' OR t.type = 'V') -- transfer transactions
      AND t.bank != ac.district_id -- transfer to/from outside bank
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
AccountOwners AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, d.client_id
    FROM disp d
),
OwnerDistrict AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.district_id
    FROM client c
),
DistrictPopulation AS (
    SELECT district_id, A8 AS population
    FROM district
),
AccountsWithInfo AS (
    SELECT bpa.account_id, bpa.opening_date, 
           tla.total_borrowed, 
           COALESCE(cp.outside_counterparties, 0) AS outside_counterparties,
           od.district_id, dp.population
    FROM BorrowingPrachatice bpa
    JOIN TotalLoanAmount tla ON bpa.account_id = tla.account_id
    LEFT JOIN Counterparties cp ON bpa.account_id = cp.account_id
    JOIN AccountOwners ao ON bpa.account_id = ao.account_id
    JOIN OwnerDistrict od ON ao.client_id = od.client_id
    JOIN DistrictPopulation dp ON od.district_id = dp.district_id
),
RankedAccounts AS (

  SELECT l.loan_id, l.amount AS approved_amount, l.date AS date_approval, l.account_id
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.duration = 24
    AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
LatestBalance AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.balance,
         t.date, t.trans_id,
         RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t.account_id, t.date ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC) AS trans_rank
  FROM trans t
  JOIN FilteredLoans l ON t.account_id = l.account_id
  WHERE t.date IN (SELECT date_approval FROM FilteredLoans WHERE account_id = t.account_id)
),
RankedBalance AS (
  SELECT account_id, balance
  FROM LatestBalance
  WHERE trans_rank = 1
),
JoinData AS (
  SELECT l.loan_id, d.A2 AS district, l.approved_amount, l.date_approval, r.balance
  FROM FilteredLoans l

  LEFT JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  LEFT JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
)

FROM JoinData
ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, date_approval ASC

TopLoanAmounts AS (

TransactionSummary AS (
    SELECT t.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
RegionLoanCounts AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(*) AS loans_in_region
    FROM loan l

    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

ClientBirthdates AS (

    FROM client
),
FinalData AS (
    SELECT 
        ldr.client_id,
        ROUND(ldr.amount, 2) AS loan_amount,
        ldr.duration AS duration_months,
        ROUND(ldr.payments * ldr.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
        ROUND(ldr.payments * ldr.duration - ldr.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
        ldr.status AS loan_status,
        ldr.district_id AS district,
        ldr.region,
        ts.trans_count,
        ts.total_deposits,

            WHEN ts.total_deposits > 2 * ldr.amount THEN 'High Income'
            WHEN ts.total_deposits > ldr.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
            ELSE 'Low Income'
        END AS income_category,
        rlc.loans_in_region,
        ras.avg_region_salary,
        cb.birth_date
    FROM LoanDistrictRegion ldr
    LEFT JOIN TransactionSummary ts ON ldr.account_id = ts.account_id
    LEFT JOIN RegionLoanCounts rlc ON ldr.region = rlc.region
    LEFT JOIN RegionAvgSalaries ras ON ldr.region = ras.region
    JOIN ClientBirthdates cb ON ldr.client_id = cb.client_id
)

    duration_months,
    total_payments,
    interest_paid,
    loan_status,
    district,
    region,
    trans_count,
    total_deposits,
    income_category,
    loans_in_region,
    avg_region_salary,
    CASE
        WHEN strftime('%m%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m%d', birth_date) THEN 
            CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER) - 1
        ELSE 
            CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)

LoanInfo AS (
    SELECT t.loan_id, t.client_id, t.amount, t.duration,
           ROUND(t.payments * t.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
           ROUND(t.payments * t.duration - t.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,

    FROM TopLoansWithTies t

AccountDistricts AS (

    FROM account a

Branches AS (
    SELECT ad.account_id, d.A6 AS district_name, d.A7 AS region_name
    FROM AccountDistricts ad

),
AccountTransactions AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(*) AS trans_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM LoanInfo)
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
RegionLoans AS (
    SELECT d.A7 AS region_name, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS region_loan_count
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A7
),
RegionAvgSalaries AS (
    SELECT A7 AS region_name, ROUND(AVG(A13), 2) AS region_avg_salary
    FROM district
    GROUP BY A7
),
ClientAgeOn20261009 AS (
    SELECT client_id,
           ((CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', birth_date) AS INTEGER)) -
           (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', birth_date))) AS completed_age
    FROM client
    WHERE client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM LoanInfo)
)
SELECT li.client_id, li.amount AS loan_amount, li.duration AS duration_months, 
       li.total_payments, li.interest_paid, li.status AS loan_status, 
       br.district_name AS district, br.region_name AS region,
       at.trans_count AS account_transaction_count, at.total_deposits,
       CASE 
           WHEN at.total_deposits > 2 * li.amount THEN 'High Income'

WITH gold_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM card c
  JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold'

branch_info AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, dist.A2 AS district_name, dist.A3 AS region
  FROM account a
  JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
  WHERE a.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
),
amounts AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loans_count AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt
  FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold_accounts)
  GROUP BY l.account_id
),
external_counterparty_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id, t.account AS counterparty_account
  FROM trans t
  JOIN gold_accounts ga ON t.account_id = ga.account_id
  WHERE t.account IS NOT NULL
    AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
    AND (t.account NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM account)) -- external accounts assumed not in internal account ids
),
external_counterparty_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT counterparty_account) AS external_count
  FROM external_counterparty_accounts
  GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT b.account_id, b.district_name, b.region,
       COALESCE(a.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
       COALESCE(a.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
       COALESCE(l.loan_cnt, 0) AS loans_taken,
       COALESCE(e.external_count, 0) AS external_counterparty_count,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(e.external_count, 0) DESC) AS rank
FROM branch_info b
LEFT JOIN amounts a ON b.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN loans_count l ON b.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN external_counterparty_counts e ON b.account_id = e.account_id
ORDER BY rank, b.account_id;

           t.client_id

),
CardCounts AS (

    GROUP BY dis.account_id
),
LoanStatus AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_defaulted,

),
LoanLabels AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           CASE

           END AS loan_standing

LoanLabelsAll AS (

),
TranStats AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_transactions_97,

           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'cash withdrawal') AND date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out_97
    FROM trans
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
PeakBalance AS (
    SELECT account_id, MAX(balance) AS max_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
FinalProfile AS (
    SELECT ao.account_id, ao.open_date, ao.gender, ao.age_at_1996,
           COALESCE(cc.cards_count, 0) AS cards,
           COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loans,
           ll.loan_standing,
           COALESCE(ts.total_transactions_97, 0) AS transactions,
           COALESCE(ts.money_in_97, 0) AS money_in,

    FROM AccountsWithOwners ao
    LEFT JOIN CardCounts cc ON ao.account_id = cc.account_id
    LEFT JOIN LoanStatus ls ON ao.account_id = ls.account_id
    LEFT JOIN LoanLabelsAll ll ON ao.account_id = ll.account_id
    LEFT JOIN TranStats ts ON ao.account_id = ts.account_id
    LEFT JOIN PeakBalance pb ON ao.account_id = pb.account_id

Ranked AS (
    SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS rank
    FROM FinalProfile
)
SELECT account_id, open_date, gender, age_at_1996 AS age, cards, loans, loan_standing, transactions, money_in, money_out, peak_balance, rank

WITH TaborAccounts AS (

  FROM account a

Owners AS (
  SELECT disp.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp
  JOIN client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'
),
CardCount AS (
  SELECT disp.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM card
  JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
  WHERE card.issued <= DATE('1996-12-31')
  GROUP BY disp.account_id
),
LoanData AS (
  SELECT loan.account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
         MAX(CASE
           WHEN loan.status = 'B' THEN 3
           WHEN loan.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 2
           WHEN loan.status = 'A' THEN 1
           ELSE 0 END) AS loan_status_rank
  FROM loan
  WHERE loan.date <= DATE('1996-12-31')
  GROUP BY loan.account_id
),
LoanStatusLabel AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         CASE 
           WHEN loan_count = 0 THEN 'no loan'
           WHEN loan_status_rank = 3 THEN 'defaulted'
           WHEN loan_status_rank IN (2) THEN 'repaying'
           ELSE 'paid off'
         END AS loan_standing
  FROM LoanData
),
Trans1997 AS (
  SELECT account_id,
         COUNT(*) AS trans_1997_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in_1997,
         SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'cash_withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out_1997,
         MAX(balance) AS peak_balance_1997
  FROM trans
  WHERE date >= DATE('1997-01-01') AND date <= DATE('1997-12-31')
  GROUP BY account_id
),
Ages AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST((julianday('1996-12-31') - julianday(birth_date))/365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age_at_1996_12_31
  FROM Owners
),
BaseData AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, t.opened_date, o.gender, a.age_at_1996_12_31
  FROM TaborAccounts t
  JOIN Owners o ON t.account_id = o.account_id
  JOIN Ages a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
),
FinalData AS (
  SELECT b.account_id, b.opened_date, b.gender, b.age_at_1996_12_31,
         COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
         COALESCE(ld.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
         COALESCE(ls.loan_standing, 'no loan') AS loan_standing,
         COALESCE(tr.trans_1997_count, 0) AS trans_1997_count,
         COALESCE(tr.money_in_1997, 0) AS money_in_1997,
         COALESCE(tr.money_out_1997, 0) AS money_out_1997,
         COALESCE(tr.peak_balance_1997, 0) AS peak_balance_1997
  FROM BaseData b
  LEFT JOIN CardCount cc ON b.account_id = cc.account_id
  LEFT JOIN LoanData ld ON b.account_id = ld.account_id
  LEFT JOIN LoanStatusLabel ls ON b.account_id = ls.account_id
  LEFT JOIN Trans1997 tr ON b.account_id = tr.account_id
),
Ranked AS (
  SELECT fd.*,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fd.peak_balance_1997 DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
  FROM FinalData fd
)
SELECT account_id, opened_date, gender, age_at_1996_12_31 AS age, card_count, loan_count, loan_standing,
       trans_1997_count, money_in_1997, money_out_1997, peak_balance_1997, peak_balance_rank
FROM Ranked
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id
LIMIT 1000;

WITH race_start_times AS (
    SELECT races.raceId, circuits.circuitRef, races.time
    FROM races
    JOIN circuits ON races.circuitId = circuits.circuitId
    WHERE races.time IS NOT NULL
),

min_start_time AS (
    SELECT MIN(time) AS earliest_start
    FROM race_start_times
),
max_start_time AS (
    SELECT MAX(time) AS latest_start
    FROM race_start_times
),

min_circuits AS (
    SELECT circuitRef
    FROM race_start_times, min_start_time
    WHERE time = earliest_start
),
max_circuits AS (
    SELECT circuitRef
    FROM race_start_times, max_start_time
    WHERE time = latest_start
),
diff_seconds AS (
    SELECT CAST((strftime('%s', max_start_time.latest_start) - strftime('%s', min_start_time.earliest_start)) AS INTEGER) AS gap_seconds
    FROM min_start_time, max_start_time
)

SELECT 
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef, ', ') FROM min_circuits) AS earliest_circuits,
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(circuitRef, ', ') FROM max_circuits) AS latest_circuits,
    gap_seconds
FROM diff_seconds
;

WITH CircuitStartTimes AS (
  SELECT
    c.circuitRef,
    r.date,
    r.time,
    datetime(r.date || 'T' || r.time) AS start_datetime
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),

GlobalMinMax AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(start_datetime) AS earliest_start_datetime,
    MAX(start_datetime) AS latest_start_datetime
  FROM CircuitStartTimes
),

EarliestCircuits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
  FROM CircuitStartTimes, GlobalMinMax
  WHERE start_datetime = earliest_start_datetime
),

LatestCircuits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
  FROM CircuitStartTimes, GlobalMinMax
  WHERE start_datetime = latest_start_datetime
),

GapSeconds AS (
  SELECT CAST((strftime('%s', latest_start_datetime) - strftime('%s', earliest_start_datetime)) AS INTEGER) AS gap_seconds
  FROM GlobalMinMax
)

SELECT
  'Earliest' AS type,
  circuitRef,
  NULL AS gap_seconds
FROM EarliestCircuits
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'Latest' AS type,
  circuitRef,
  gap_seconds
FROM LatestCircuits CROSS JOIN GapSeconds
ORDER BY type, circuitRef;

  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
OxygenCounts AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS oxygen_count

)

FROM OxygenCounts
WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM MoleculesWithSingleBond);

WITH molecule_bond_types AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),

molecule_saturation_groups AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    CASE WHEN total_bonds = single_bonds THEN 'all_single_bonds' ELSE 'other' END AS saturation_group
  FROM molecule_bond_types
),

molecule_labels AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 WHEN label = '-' THEN 0 ELSE NULL END AS is_carcinogenic
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label IN ('+', '-')
),

saturation_carcinogenic_diff AS (
  SELECT
    sg.saturation_group,
    SUM(COALESCE(ml.is_carcinogenic, 0)) - SUM(COALESCE(1 - ml.is_carcinogenic, 0)) AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
  FROM molecule_saturation_groups sg
  JOIN molecule_labels ml ON sg.molecule_id = ml.molecule_id
  GROUP BY sg.saturation_group
)

SELECT saturation_group, carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM saturation_carcinogenic_diff
ORDER BY saturation_group
LIMIT 1000;

WITH ElementRarity AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM atom
  GROUP BY element
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1
),
RareElementsMolecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id, a.element
  FROM atom a
  JOIN ElementRarity er ON a.element = er.element
),
CarcinogenicMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
),
QualifiedMolecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT rem.molecule_id
  FROM RareElementsMolecules rem
  JOIN CarcinogenicMolecules cm ON rem.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
),
RareElementAtoms AS (
  SELECT a.atom_id, a.molecule_id
  FROM atom a
  JOIN ElementRarity er ON a.element = er.element
),
RareElementBonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN atom a ON b.molecule_id = a.molecule_id AND (b.bond_id = a.atom_id OR b.bond_id = a.atom_id)
  WHERE a.atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM RareElementAtoms)
),
BondCount AS (
  SELECT rea.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count
  FROM RareElementAtoms rea
  JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = rea.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a ON (b.atom1_id = a.atom_id OR b.atom2_id = a.atom_id) AND a.element IN (SELECT element FROM ElementRarity)
  GROUP BY rea.molecule_id
)
SELECT qm.molecule_id, COALESCE(bc.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count
FROM QualifiedMolecules qm
LEFT JOIN BondCount bc ON qm.molecule_id = bc.molecule_id
ORDER BY qm.molecule_id;

WITH MoleculeAtomCounts AS (
  SELECT
    mol.molecule_id,
    mol.label AS carcinogenicity,
    COUNT(a.atom_id) AS total_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
  FROM molecule mol
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = mol.molecule_id
  GROUP BY mol.molecule_id
),
MoleculeBondAtoms AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_id,
    b.molecule_id,
    a1.element AS element1,
    a2.element AS element2,
    b.bond_type
  FROM bond b
  LEFT JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = substr(b.bond_id, 1, instr(b.bond_id, '_') - 1)
  LEFT JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = substr(b.bond_id, instr(b.bond_id, '_') + 1)
),
MoleculeBondCounts AS (
  SELECT
    mol.molecule_id,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS total_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (b.element1 = 'C' OR b.element2 = 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_touching_bonds
  FROM molecule mol
  LEFT JOIN MoleculeBondAtoms b ON b.molecule_id = mol.molecule_id
  GROUP BY mol.molecule_id
),
FilteredMolecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM MoleculeAtomCounts
  WHERE carbon_atoms > 0
)
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
    ORDER BY bcounts.carbon_touching_bonds DESC, a_counts.total_atoms DESC, a_counts.molecule_id ASC
  ) AS rank,
  a_counts.molecule_id,
  a_counts.carcinogenicity,
  a_counts.total_atoms AS number_of_atoms,
  bcounts.total_bonds AS number_of_bonds,
  a_counts.carbon_atoms AS number_of_carbon_atoms,
  a_counts.chlorine_atoms AS number_of_chlorine_atoms,
  bcounts.carbon_touching_bonds AS number_of_carbon_touching_bonds,
  bcounts.multiple_bonds AS number_of_multiple_bonds
FROM FilteredMolecules f
JOIN MoleculeAtomCounts a_counts ON f.molecule_id = a_counts.molecule_id
JOIN MoleculeBondCounts bcounts ON f.molecule_id = bcounts.molecule_id
ORDER BY
  bcounts.carbon_touching_bonds DESC,
  a_counts.total_atoms DESC,
  a_counts.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

WITH carbon_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    a.element AS element,
    b.bond_type
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON (
    (a.atom_id = c.atom_id AND a.element != 'C') OR (a.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND a.element != 'C')
  )
  JOIN atom c_atom ON (
    (c_atom.atom_id = c.atom_id AND c_atom.element = 'C') OR
    (c_atom.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND c_atom.element = 'C')
  )
  JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '-'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
)

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM carbon_bonds
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;

SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM triple_bond_elements
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element ASC;

treatment.sql:
WITH triple_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
participating_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT element, molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM triple_bonds)
)
SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM participating_atoms
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element ASC;

baseline.sql:
WITH MoleculeAtoms AS (
  SELECT atom_id, element
  FROM atom
  WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR397')
), BondedAtoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id IN (
    SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR397')
  )
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT atom_id2 as atom_id FROM connected WHERE bond_id IN (
    SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = 'TR397')
  )
), BondAtomsPresent AS (
  SELECT atom_id
  FROM BondedAtoms
  WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM MoleculeAtoms)
)
SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM MoleculeAtoms
WHERE atom_id IN (SELECT atom_id FROM BondAtomsPresent)
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;
